decisions.reason: Although it has remained on the website since 2023, this recruitment service is far from the firm's maritime core and stated strategic direction, so the public commitment is too limited to justify continued escalation.

This service builds on the firm's established crewing capabilities, has been publicly maintained since 2023, and management is likely to continue it because the investment and strategic fit make disappointing traction look temporary.
The maritime education programme is closely tied to the firm's training capabilities, has its own visible launch identity, and early partner-network growth supports continued commitment.

Emissions monitoring and compliance services sit at the centre of the firm's announced push toward environmental performance and already show concrete execution success, reinforcing management's commitment.

The dashboard is integrated into the firm's PAL software and directly supports its digitalisation and compliance strategy, so prior development effort and strategic visibility strongly favour persistence.

The cost simulation tool is a publicly presented, software-integrated extension of the firm's emissions offering, and management is likely to retain it because it complements the broader compliance platform.
